purpose: Canonical, outcome-blind event-to-exposure mapping for the Causal Event-Dislocation Engine (CEDE).

earnings.rationale: Only a same-issuer earnings contract is treated as a direct earnings catalyst.

geopolitics.rationale: Commodity ETPs are the direct transmission vehicle. Sector equities and producers add company and equity-market basis risk, so they cannot create a second exposure to the same geopolitical event.

macro.rationale: Each current tariff episode is one basket, rather than a set of independent country or company trades. A new macro event needs an explicit, pre-entry component review before it can be traded.
